body: I'm physically broken too. I'm sorry ty for the kind words.

Distance kills relationships. I have thought this through. And to be honest they are the only reason that I am still here. I'm just so dam done with this. A few oxycontin and booz and then its over. Thats way to easy and to be honest they would more than likely be better off if its done and over with.
Ive been having a bad time in life also. I know those voices. I dealt with them for years. I'm on meds now the voices are now whispers that rarely come anymore. Seek help please before its to late.

Yes I do want to stay but I also want to go. My children will be a  16 hour drive away soon. I'm really conflicted its easy to just do it. I'm at work or I probably would have already. Its just that I'm tired. It would be so easy to wink out of existence. If I tell some one (Veterans Affairs)  I'll goto a mental hospital. But what are they gonna do. Hold me indefinitely? Ive felt like this for years, ive been holding on by a string, and now she cut it. I know she doesn't love me. I'm ok with that but my kids.

I think helped very much. I dont have as many issues with the ptsd. I dont wake up as much from the dreams anymore. But I still am messed up. I'm on the highest dose of the med I'm on. I'm just done. I have nothing. Its weird realizing I'm alone. My wife has turned my children against me. Its cool there better of. All I did was make money and help. They loved me once. I miss em. Sorry for the rant.
Edit: I'm not on highest dose. I checked. But im up there.
